title: Odor prevention only so-so
text: Odor prevention only so-so. This is a nice long, round can, but the standard 13-gallon bag is too wide and not long enough. They still work. The lid of the can is plastic, and a bit poorly made. Mine scratched immediately. There is a odor control device at the top of the can, but the minute you open the can, the stink of the trash just rushes out. The lid stays open way too long. I have to close it by hand immediately to keep the smell in. I think the can itself is better because it is metal and that is why I will keep it. My plastic garbage can stunk and no matter how much I cleaned it, the smell never left the plastic. This one is fine after a wash. I don't understand why they didn't invest in the making the lid metal. It would be perfect.
